facts.title: Unicorn Studio — Craft Interactive Graphics that Ship
facts.description: Design production-ready web components with shaders, media, 3D, and interactive motion in a visual canvas.

research.name: Unicorn Studio
research.note: A browser-based visual editor for shader, 3D and interactive motion scenes that embed on sites through a small JS SDK.

effects: 75+ stackable shader effects such as dither, distortion, blur and retro, driven by scroll, hover and mouse events
Scroll Timeline for staging scroll events as bars
GPU text layers rendered as shader materials
